{"test_name":"Ledger_2297_Objection1","test_code":"// Copyright (c) All contributors. All rights reserved.\n// Licensed under the MIT license. See LICENSE file in the project root for full license information.\n\nusing System.Collections.Generic;\nusing System.Linq;\nusing System.Threading;\nusing System.Threading.Tasks;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.Syntax;\nusing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Testing;\n\npublic class Ledger_2297_Objection1\n{\n    [Fact]\n    public async Task GeneratedCompositeResolverAndObjectFormattersHaveExcludeFromCodeCoverage()\n    {\n        string source = \"\"\"\nusing MessagePack;\n\nnamespace TempProject\n{\n    [GeneratedMessagePackResolver]\n    public partial class MyResolver\n    {\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject]\n    public class IntKeyObject\n    {\n        [Key(0)]\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        [Key(1)]\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n\n    [MessagePackObject(true)]\n    public class StringKeyObject\n    {\n        public int Id { get; set; }\n\n        public string Name { get; set; }\n    }\n}\n\"\"\";\n\n        ImmutableArray<MetadataReference> net80Refs = await ReferenceAssemblies.Net.Net80.ResolveAsync(LanguageNames.CSharp, CancellationToken.None);\n        IEnumerable<MetadataReference> messagePackRefs = ReferencesHelper.GetReferences(ReferencesSet.MessagePack);\n        MetadataReference[] references = net80Refs.Concat(messagePackRefs).ToArray();\n\n        CSharpCompilation compilation = CSharpCompilation.Create(\n            \"TestAssembly\",\n            new[] { CSharpSyntaxTree.ParseText(source, new CSharpParseOptions(LanguageVersion.Latest)) },\n            references,\n            new CSharpCompilationOptions(OutputKind.DynamicallyLinkedLibrary));\n\n        GeneratorDriver driver = CSharpGeneratorDriver.Create(new MessagePack.SourceGenerator.MessagePackGenerator().AsSourceGenerator());\n        driver = driver.RunGeneratorsAndUpdateCompilation(compilation, out Compilation outputCompilation, out ImmutableArray<Diagnostic> generatorDiagnostics);\n        GeneratorDriverRunResult runResult = driver.GetRunResult();\n\n        Assert.Empty(generatorDiagnostics.Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n        foreach (GeneratorRunResult result in runResult.Results)\n        {\n            Assert.Null(result.Exception);\n        }\n\n        Assert.Empty(outputCompilation.GetDiagnostics().Where(d => d.Severity == DiagnosticSeverity.Error));\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"System.Diagnostics.CodeAnalysis.ExcludeFromCodeCoverageAttribute\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterResolverInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.IFormatterResolver\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterResolverInterface);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol formatterGenericInterface = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"MessagePack.Formatters.IMessagePackFormatter`1\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(formatterGenericInterface);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol intKeyObjectType = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.IntKeyObject\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(intKeyObjectType);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol stringKeyObjectType = outputCompilation.GetTypeByMetadataName(\"TempProject.StringKeyObject\")!;\n        Assert.NotNull(stringKeyObjectType);\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol intKeyFormatterInterface = formatterGenericInterface.Construct(intKeyObjectType);\n        INamedTypeSymbol stringKeyFormatterInterface = formatterGenericInterface.Construct(stringKeyObjectType);\n\n        var generatedTypes = new List<INamedTypeSymbol>();\n        foreach (GeneratedSourceResult generatedSource in runResult.Results.SelectMany(r => r.GeneratedSources))\n        {\n            SemanticModel semanticModel = outputCompilation.GetSemanticModel(generatedSource.SyntaxTree);\n            SyntaxNode root = await generatedSource.SyntaxTree.GetRootAsync();\n            foreach (TypeDeclarationSyntax typeDecl in root.DescendantNodes().OfType<TypeDeclarationSyntax>())\n            {\n                if (semanticModel.GetDeclaredSymbol(typeDecl) is INamedTypeSymbol typeSymbol)\n                {\n                    generatedTypes.Add(typeSymbol);\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        bool HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(INamedTypeSymbol symbol) =>\n            symbol.GetAttributes().Any(a => SymbolEqualityComparer.Default.Equals(a.AttributeClass, excludeFromCodeCoverageAttr));\n\n        List<INamedTypeSymbol> resolverTypes = generatedTypes\n            .Where(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(formatterResolverInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default))\n            .ToList();\n        Assert.NotEmpty(resolverTypes);\n\n        foreach (INamedTypeSymbol resolverType in resolverTypes)\n        {\n            Assert.True(\n                HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(resolverType),\n                $\"Generated composite resolver '{resolverType.ToDisplayString()}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n\n            INamedTypeSymbol? formatterCacheType = resolverType.GetTypeMembers(\"FormatterCache\").FirstOrDefault();\n            Assert.NotNull(formatterCacheType);\n            Assert.True(\n                HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(formatterCacheType!),\n                $\"Generated nested type '{formatterCacheType!.ToDisplayString()}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n        }\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? intKeyFormatterType = generatedTypes\n            .FirstOrDefault(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(intKeyFormatterInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));\n        Assert.NotNull(intKeyFormatterType);\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(intKeyFormatterType!),\n            $\"Generated object formatter '{intKeyFormatterType!.ToDisplayString()}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n\n        INamedTypeSymbol? stringKeyFormatterType = generatedTypes\n            .FirstOrDefault(t => t.AllInterfaces.Contains(stringKeyFormatterInterface, SymbolEqualityComparer.Default));\n        Assert.NotNull(stringKeyFormatterType);\n        Assert.True(\n            HasExcludeFromCodeCoverage(stringKeyFormatterType!),\n            $\"Generated object formatter '{stringKeyFormatterType!.ToDisplayString()}' is missing [ExcludeFromCodeCoverage].\");\n    }\n}\n"}
